description: Send a text chat request through the dispatch gateway: it applies your policy, runs the best eligible model, and returns the completion, usage and the full dispatch_receipt (chosen model, reason, cost, savings, attempts) — the same as POST /v1/chat/completions with a `dispatch` object. This makes a REAL model call billed to your own provider keys stored for your org (POST /dispatch/keys), and the spend is recorded against your org. Requires your service API key on the MCP connection (x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer); the operator key and anonymous callers get dispatch_requires_api_key, and the local STDIO server refuses with dispatch_requires_hosted_mcp. Pass prompt (with optional system) or messages, not both. Text-only, single-choice, non-streaming; no tools/functions. Refusals carry the same error codes as HTTP. Calls can take a while with failover: bound them with dispatch.failover.timeout_ms and dispatch.failover.max_attempts, and set LLM_PRICING_MCP_TIMEOUT_MS=120000 when using the npx bridge.

dispatch.description: Dispatch policy — the same object as the HTTP `dispatch` body field (OpenAI SDK extra_body={'dispatch': {...}}). Omit for the balanced objective with failover on.

allow.description: Only these models or 'provider:<name>' entries may be dispatched

country.description: ISO-3166 alpha-2 country whose currency to present

currency.description: Also present receipt money figures in this ISO-4217 currency

deny.description: Never dispatch these models or 'provider:<name>' entries

failover.description: Reliability knobs for the dispatch loop

enabled.description: Re-dispatch to the next-best candidate on a retryable failure

max_attempts.description: Upper bound on provider attempts (server default 3)

timeout_ms.description: Per-attempt provider timeout in ms (server default 30000)

max_request_cost_usd.description: Max estimated USD for this request (prompt tokens x input price + max_tokens x output price); with a shadow the cap covers primary + shadow

objective.description: Objective preset used to order eligible candidates ('pinned' needs pinned_model)

pinned_model.description: Required when objective is 'pinned'; exactly one model

preferred_provider.description: Provider that gets the router's preference boost

request_id.description: Idempotency key for the spend record

session_id.description: Session tag for the usage ledger

shadow.description: Optional shadow A/B run; give exactly one of model / objective. Its text is discarded

model.description: Catalogue model name to shadow with

objective.description: Shadow with the top other candidate under this objective

task_type.description: Task type (inferred from the messages when omitted)

max_tokens.description: Max completion tokens (server default when omitted)

messages.description: OpenAI-style chat messages (use this or prompt, not both)

model.description: Requested model name (default 'auto'); the policy decides what runs

prompt.description: The user prompt (use this or messages, not both)

stop.description: Stop sequence or list of stop sequences

system.description: Optional system prompt, only with prompt

name: dispatch
